feeds.title: Council Korean Americans (CKA)
feeds.description: The Council of Korean Americans (CKA) is a national nonprofit organization. Their mission is to advance the national voice and influence of the Korean American community.The news section of the website features news articles, press releases, and event information about the CKA and its work.

feeds.title: Chef Chris Cho Blog
feeds.description: Chris Cho is a Korean American Chef with over 10+ years of professional cooking experience. He is also the owner of two of Philly's best Korean restaurants, serving more than 300 people per day. During the Pandemic, Chris decided to share all his recipes online, which ended up going viral. Now, he is sharing his Korean culture and cuisine though his interesting blog.

feeds.title: The Korean Vegan Blog
feeds.description: The Korean Vegan is a food blog started by Joanne Molinaro in 2016. The Korean Vegan Blog consists of recipes that re-imagine traditional Korean meals through plant-based adaptations. In addition to recipes, the blog also features posts about Molinaro's life stories, reflections, and writing

feeds.title: Korean American Youth Artists of Texas Blog
feeds.description: The Korean American Youth Artists of Texas is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization established in the summer of 2021 by Korean American teenagers who wanted to bridge the growing divide between Korean American children and their Korean ancestry.Their members seek to accomplish this goal by exploring traditional and contemporary Korean art forms and sharing Korean culture with the greater community.

feeds.title: Maangchi
feeds.description: Maangchi Blog Covers Korean cooking, recipes, videos, cookbooks, and photos, by Maangchi, who shares her knowledge, advice, photos, tips & tricks. It features the author's life, Korean food, events, meetups, contests, interesting stories, and updates from her lovely readers!

feeds.title: Alliance for Korea United Blog
feeds.description: Alliance for Korea United is a coalition of Korean American organizations and individuals advancing the cause for a unified Korea that fulfills the historic ideals and aspirations of the Korean people. Visit their blog and read articles on the Korean community, events, meetings of government relevance, new American policies, feature stories, and news.

feeds.title: Adventures With NieNie Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie, also known as NieNie, is the author of Adventures with NieNie, a fun light-hearted travel blog about her travel experiences. She is an expert on travel in South Korea and the Philippines and frequently shares travel tips, must-see itineraries, mouth-watering food options, and inspiration for your next adventure.

feeds.title: Korean Bapsang
feeds.description: Hyosun started this blog as a way to teach her children how to cook the food they grew up with. Through this blog, she hope to share the secrets of classic Korean home cooking and some of my other home favorites.

feeds.title: Korean American Historical Society
feeds.description: Founded in 1985, Korean American Historical Society (KAHS) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to enriching the collective memory of Korean Americans through collecting, maintaining, and transmitting the heritage and achievements of Koreans living in the United States and abroad.Learn more about the Korean culture, heritage, and their community living in America through their historical blog.

feeds.title: KAAN Blog
feeds.description: KAAN was founded in 1998 to build a national Korean adoption community with adoptees at its center. We seek to better understand and improve the lives of adoptees and their families through our conferences and other services. Visit their blog stories from the KAAN Community and the latest KAAN news.

feeds.title: Mommy Diary
feeds.description: Mommy Diary is a lifestyle blog with the best motherhood tips and luxury travel ideas. You can find baby, pregnancy, postpartum, special needs, family and home articles.

feeds.title: Korean American Foundation NY
feeds.description: The Korean American Foundation of New York (KAFUSANY) is a non-profit organization that was founded in 1986 to promote cultural understanding and exchange between Korea and the United States. The foundation provides scholarships to orphaned and disadvantaged Korean children, supports Korean War veterans, and sponsors cultural programs between the two countries Their blog provides information about the foundation's mission, goals, and activities, and also features news articles, event listings, and photos of the foundation's work.

feeds.title: Kimchi Mamas
feeds.description: Kimchi Mamas is a blog that features a group of women who write about their experiences as mothers, wives, daughters, friends, and individuals, all while balancing the demands of their Korean heritage and their Western surroundings. The blog covers a wide range of topics, including parenting, food, culture, identity, and current events.

feeds.title: The Korea Daily
feeds.description: The Korea Daily is the most-read and largest Korean media in the US and a Korean language publisher, both newspaper and online media, serving breaking news, local news, and national and international news since 1974.
